title.zh: 卷二十三 本紀第二十三: 武宗二
title.raw: 卷二十三 本紀第二十三: 武宗二 Volume 23 Annals 23: Wuzong 2

sentences.zh: 二年春正月己丑，從皇太子請，罷宮師府，設賓客、諭德、贊善如故。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, on jichou day, at the crown prince's request, the crown prince's tutorate was abolished; guests, instructors, and assistants were established as before.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, spring, first month, on jichou day, at the crown prince's request, the crown prince's tutorate was abolished; guests, instructors, and assistants were established as before.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，越王禿剌有罪賜死。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Prince Tula of Yue, having committed a crime, was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Prince Tula of Yue, having committed a crime, was granted death.

sentences.zh: 禁日者、方士出入諸王、公主、近侍及諸官之門。

translations.literal: Day diviners and recipe masters were forbidden to enter the gates of princes, princesses, close attendants, and other officials.
translations.idiomatic: Day diviners and recipe masters were forbidden to enter the gates of princes, princesses, close attendants, and other officials.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，皇太子、諸王、百官上尊號曰統天繼聖欽文英武大章孝皇帝。

translations.literal: On xinmao day the crown prince, princes, and all officials presented the honorific title Emperor of Harmonizing Heaven, Continuing the Sage, Revering Culture, Martial and Civil in Great Splendor, and Great Filial Brightness.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the crown prince, princes, and all officials presented the honorific title Emperor of Harmonizing Heaven, Continuing the Sage, Revering Culture, Martial and Civil in Great Splendor, and Great Filial Brightness.

sentences.zh: 乙未，恭謝太廟。

translations.literal: On yiwei day sacrificial thanks were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day sacrificial thanks were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔天下弛山澤之禁，恤流移，毋令見戶包納差稅；

translations.literal: On bingshen day an edict ordered the realm to relax prohibitions on mountains and marshes, succor the displaced, and not require registered households to pay corvée taxes on behalf of absentees;
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict ordered the realm to relax prohibitions on mountains and marshes, succor the displaced, and not require registered households to pay corvée taxes on behalf of absentees;

sentences.zh: 被災百姓，內郡免差稅一年，江淮免夏稅；

translations.literal: commoners in disaster areas — inner circuits were exempt from corvée taxes for one year, Jianghuai was exempt from summer tax;
translations.idiomatic: commoners in disaster areas — inner circuits were exempt from corvée taxes for one year, Jianghuai was exempt from summer tax;

sentences.zh: 內外大小職官普覃散官一等，有出身人考滿者，加散官一等。

translations.literal: all civil and military officials at every level were granted one grade of nominal rank; those with formal appointments who had completed their term of service were given one additional grade of nominal rank.
translations.idiomatic: all civil and military officials at every level were granted one grade of nominal rank; those with formal appointments who had completed their term of service were given one additional grade of nominal rank.

sentences.zh: 己亥，封知樞密院事容國公床兀兒為句容郡王。

translations.literal: On jihai day Chuangwu'er, Duke of Rong State and privy council administrator, was enfeoffed Prince of Jurong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Chuangwu'er, Duke of Rong State and privy council administrator, was enfeoffed Prince of Jurong Commandery.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，塔思不花、乞臺普濟言：「諸人恃恩徑奏，璽書不由中書，直下翰林院給與者，今核其數，自大德六年至至大元年所出，凡六千三百餘道，皆於田土、戶口、金銀鐵冶、增余課程、進貢奇貨、錢谷、選法、詞訟、造作等事，害及於民，請盡追奪之。

translations.literal: On yisi day Tashihwa and Chigai Puji said: "People relying on grace memorialize directly; imperial letters not passing through the central secretariat but issued straight from the Hanlin academy — having now tallied their number, from the sixth year of Dade through the first year of Zhida, more than six thousand three hundred were issued, all concerning land, households, gold and silver, ironworks, surplus tax quotas, tribute of rare goods, grain funds, selection law, litigation, construction, and other matters — harming the people. We request that all be revoked and recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Tashihwa and Chigai Puji said, "People relying on grace memorialize directly; imperial letters not passing through the central secretariat but issued straight from the Hanlin academy — having now tallied their number, from the sixth year of Dade through the first year of Zhida, more than 6,300 were issued, all concerning land, households, gold and silver, ironworks, surplus tax quotas, tribute of rare goods, grain funds, selection law, litigation, construction, and other matters — harming the people. We request that all be revoked and recovered.

sentences.zh: 今後有不由中書者，乞勿與。

translations.literal: From now on, for those not passing through the central secretariat, we request that none be granted.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, for those not passing through the central secretariat, we request that none be granted.

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 丙午，定制大成至聖文宣王春秋二丁釋奠用太牢。

translations.literal: On bingwu day regulations were fixed that the spring and autumn libation sacrifices to the Great Completion Sage Master of Culture use the grand offering.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day regulations were fixed that the spring and autumn libation sacrifices to the Great Completion Sage Master of Culture use the grand offering.

sentences.zh: 戊申，叠裏貼木兒不花進鷹犬，命歲以幣帛千匹、鈔千錠與之。

translations.literal: On wushen day Dieli Temür Buqa presented hawks and hunting dogs; an order directed that each year he be given one thousand bolts of silks and cloths and one thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Dieli Temür Buqa presented hawks and hunting dogs; an order directed that each year he be given 1,000 bolts of silks and cloths and 1,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，鑄金印賜句容郡王床兀兒。

translations.literal: Second month, on wuwu day a gold seal was cast and granted to Prince of Jurong Commandery Chuangwu'er.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on wuwu day a gold seal was cast and granted to Prince of Jurong Commandery Chuangwu'er.

sentences.zh: 賑真定路饑民糧萬石，塔塔境六千石。

translations.literal: Famine victims of Zhending Route were relieved with ten thousand shi of grain; the Tatar frontier with six thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: Famine victims of Zhending Route were relieved with 10,000 shi of grain; the Tatar frontier with 6,000 shi.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，皇太子幸五臺佛寺。

translations.literal: On guihai day the crown prince visited the Buddhist monasteries of Mount Wutai.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the crown prince visited the Buddhist monasteries of Mount Wutai.

sentences.zh: 罷行泉府院，以市舶歸之行省。

translations.literal: The Quanfu Court was abolished; maritime trade was returned to branch secretariats.
translations.idiomatic: The Quanfu Court was abolished; maritime trade was returned to branch secretariats.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以和林屯田去秋收九萬餘石，其宣慰司官吏、部校、軍士給賞有差。

translations.literal: On yichou day because Karakorum garrison-farm fields yielded more than ninety thousand shi at autumn harvest, the pacification commission officials, platoon commanders, and soldiers were rewarded in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day because Karakorum garrison-farm fields yielded more than 90,000 shi at autumn harvest, the pacification commission officials, platoon commanders, and soldiers were rewarded in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 己巳，太陰犯亢。

translations.literal: On jisi day the moon encroached upon Kui.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the moon encroached upon Kui.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太陰犯氐。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the moon encroached upon Di.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the moon encroached upon Di.

sentences.zh: 調國王部及忽裏合赤、兀魯帶、朵來等軍九千五百人赴和林。

translations.literal: Nine thousand five hundred troops of princes' divisions and the armies of Quliqache, Urudai, and Duolai were mobilized to proceed to Karakorum.
translations.idiomatic: 9,500 troops of princes' divisions and the armies of Quliqache, Urudai, and Duolai were mobilized to proceed to Karakorum.

sentences.zh: 壬申，令各衛董屯田官三年一易。

translations.literal: On renshen day an order directed that garrison-farm officers of each guard rotate every three years.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day an order directed that garrison-farm officers of each guard rotate every three years.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，弛中都酒禁。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the wine prohibition in the Central Capital was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the wine prohibition in the Central Capital was relaxed.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，遼陽行省右丞洪重喜訴高麗國王王章不奉國法恣暴等事，中書省臣請令重喜與高麗王辯對。

translations.literal: Third month, on jichou day Hong Chongxi, right vice director of the Liaoyang branch secretariat, accused King Wang Jang of Koryo of not obeying the laws of the state and acting with wanton violence, and other matters; central secretariat officials requested that Chongxi and the King of Koryo be ordered to argue face to face.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on jichou day Hong Chongxi, right vice director of the Liaoyang branch secretariat, accused King Wang Jang of Koryo of not obeying the laws of the state and acting with wanton violence, and other matters; central secretariat officials requested that Chongxi and the King of Koryo be ordered to argue face to face.

sentences.zh: 敕中書毋令辯對，令高麗王從太后之五臺山。

translations.literal: An edict directed the central secretariat not to order a face-to-face argument, but ordered the King of Koryo to follow the empress dowager to Mount Wutai.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed the central secretariat not to order a face-to-face argument, but ordered the King of Koryo to follow the empress dowager to Mount Wutai.

sentences.zh: 梁王在雲南有風疾，以諸王老的代梁王鎮雲南，賜金二百五十兩、銀七百五十兩，從者幣帛有差。

translations.literal: The Prince of Liang residing in Yunnan had wind illness; Prince Laodi was sent to replace the Prince of Liang in governing Yunnan, granted two hundred fifty taels of gold and seven hundred fifty taels of silver, and followers granted silks and cloths in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Liang residing in Yunnan had wind illness; Prince Laodi was sent to replace the Prince of Liang in governing Yunnan, granted 250 taels of gold and 750 taels of silver, and followers granted silks and cloths in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 摘五衛軍五十人隸中都虎賁司，封諸王也速不幹為襄寧王。

translations.literal: Fifty soldiers from the five guards were detached and assigned to the Central Capital Tiger Guard Office; Prince Yeshi Buqa was enfeoffed Prince of Xiangning.
translations.idiomatic: 50 soldiers from the five guards were detached and assigned to the Central Capital Tiger Guard Office; Prince Yeshi Buqa was enfeoffed Prince of Xiangning.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，罷杭州白雲宗攝所，立湖廣頭陀禪錄司。

translations.literal: On xinmao day the Hangzhou Baiyun sect administrative office was abolished, and the Huguang Head Monk-Chan Record Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Hangzhou Baiyun sect administrative office was abolished, and the Huguang Head Monk-Chan Record Office was established.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賜雲南王老的金印。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Prince Laodi of Yunnan was granted a gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Prince Laodi of Yunnan was granted a gold seal.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太陰犯氐。

translations.literal: On wuxu day the moon encroached upon Di.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the moon encroached upon Di.

sentences.zh: 己亥，熒惑犯歲星。

translations.literal: On jihai day Mars encroached upon Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Mars encroached upon Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 封公主阿剌的納八剌為趙國公主，駙馬註安為趙王。

translations.literal: Princess Aradnabal was enfeoffed Grand Princess of Zhao State, and imperial son-in-law Zhu'an was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Aradnabal was enfeoffed Grand Princess of Zhao State, and imperial son-in-law Zhu'an was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，中書省臣言：「國家歲賦有常，頃以歲儉，所入曾不及半，而去歲所支，鈔至千萬錠，糧三百萬石。

translations.literal: On jiachen day central secretariat officials said: "State annual levies have fixed quotas; recently because of years of famine revenue once fell to less than half, while last year's expenditures reached ten million ingots of notes and three million shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day central secretariat officials said, "State annual levies have fixed quotas; recently because of years of famine revenue once fell to less than half, while last year's expenditures reached 10 million ingots of notes and 3 million shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 陛下嘗命汰其求芻粟者，而宣徽院孛可孫竟不能行，視去歲反多三十萬石，請用知錢谷者二三員於宣徽院佐而理之。

translations.literal: Your Majesty once ordered reduction of those seeking fodder and grain, yet Lekesun of the Bureau of Palace Provisions ultimately could not implement it; compared with last year it increased by three hundred thousand shi instead — we request that two or three persons versed in money and grain affairs be placed in the Bureau of Palace Provisions to assist in management."
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty once ordered reduction of those seeking fodder and grain, yet Lekesun of the Bureau of Palace Provisions ultimately could not implement it; compared with last year it increased by 300,000 shi instead — we request that two or three persons versed in money and grain affairs be placed in the Bureau of Palace Provisions to assist in management."

sentences.zh: 又，中書省斷事官，大德十年四十三員，今皇太子位增二員，諸王闊闊出、剌馬甘禿剌亦各增一員，非舊制。

translations.literal: Also, central secretariat adjudication officials: in the tenth year of Dade forty-three positions; now the crown prince's establishment added two, Prince Kuokuochu and imperial son-in-law Gantula each also added one — not the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Also, central secretariat adjudication officials: in the tenth year of Dade 43 positions; now the crown prince's establishment added two, Prince Kuokuochu and imperial son-in-law Gantula each also added one — not the old system.

sentences.zh: 臣等以為皇太子位所增宜存，諸王者宜罷。

translations.literal: We your ministers consider that those added to the crown prince's establishment should remain; those added for princes should be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: We your ministers consider that those added to the crown prince's establishment should remain; those added for princes should be abolished."

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: Both approved.
translations.idiomatic: Both approved.

sentences.zh: 升掌醫署為典醫監。

translations.literal: The Medical Superintendent Office was elevated to the Directorate of Medicine.
translations.idiomatic: The Medical Superintendent Office was elevated to the Directorate of Medicine.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，中書省臣言：「中書為百司之首，宜先汰冗員。

translations.literal: On yisi day central secretariat officials said: "The central secretariat is head of all offices; redundant personnel should first be trimmed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day central secretariat officials said, "The central secretariat is head of all offices; redundant personnel should first be trimmed.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「百司所汰，卿等定議；

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "For all offices that are trimmed, you are to fix the deliberation;
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "For all offices that are trimmed, you are to fix the deliberation;

sentences.zh: 省臣去留，朕自思之。

translations.literal: as for which secretariat officials stay or go, We shall consider it Ourselves."
translations.idiomatic: as for which secretariat officials stay or go, We shall consider it Ourselves."

sentences.zh: 」己酉，濟陰、定陶雹。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Jiyin, Dingtao, and other places suffered hail.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Jiyin, Dingtao, and other places suffered hail.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，中書省臣言：「江浙杭州驛，半歲之間，使人過者千二百餘，有桑兀、寶合丁等進獅、豹、鴉、鶻，留二十有七日，人畜食肉千三百餘斤。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiayin day central secretariat officials said: "At the Jiang-Zhe Hangzhou relay station, within half a year more than one thousand two hundred envoys passed through; Sangwu, Baoheding, and others presented lions, leopards, crows, and falcons, staying twenty-seven days, and men and beasts consumed more than one thousand three hundred jin of meat.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on jiayin day central secretariat officials said, "At the Jiang-Zhe Hangzhou relay station, within half a year more than 1,200 envoys passed through; Sangwu, Baoheding, and others presented lions, leopards, crows, and falcons, staying 27 days, and men and beasts consumed more than 1,300 jin of meat.

sentences.zh: 請自今遠方以奇獸異寶來者，依驛遞；

translations.literal: We request that from now on those coming from distant regions with rare beasts and exotic treasures follow the relay system;
translations.idiomatic: We request that from now on those coming from distant regions with rare beasts and exotic treasures follow the relay system;

sentences.zh: 其商人因有所獻者，令自備資力。

translations.literal: for merchants who happen to have something to present, let them supply their own expenses."
translations.idiomatic: for merchants who happen to have something to present, let them supply their own expenses."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，立興聖宮江淮財賦總管府，詔諭中外。

translations.literal: On xinyou day the Xingsheng Palace Jianghuai Finance Chief Commission was established; an edict announced it throughout inner and outer domains.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Xingsheng Palace Jianghuai Finance Chief Commission was established; an edict announced it throughout inner and outer domains.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，摘漢軍五千，給田十萬頃，於直沽沿海口屯種，又益以康裏軍二千，立鎮守海口屯儲親軍都指揮使司。

translations.literal: On guihai day five thousand Han troops were detached, granted one hundred thousand qing of fields, and garrison-farmed at the coastal mouth of Zhigu; two thousand Khorchi troops were added, and the Garrison and Storage Elite Army Command of Haikou was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day 5,000 Han troops were detached, granted 100,000 qing of fields, and garrison-farmed at the coastal mouth of Zhigu; 2,000 Khorchi troops were added, and the Garrison and Storage Elite Army Command of Haikou was established.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔中都創皇城角樓。

translations.literal: On renwu day an edict ordered construction of corner towers for the Central Capital's inner city wall.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict ordered construction of corner towers for the Central Capital's inner city wall.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「今農事正殷，蝗蝝遍野，百姓艱食，乞依前旨罷其役。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Now farming is at its busiest, locust nymphs cover the fields, and the people lack food — we request that corvée be halted according to the previous order.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Now farming is at its busiest, locust nymphs cover the fields, and the people lack food — we request that corvée be halted according to the previous order.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「皇城若無角樓，何以壯觀！

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "If the inner city wall has no corner towers, how can it be a grand sight!
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "If the inner city wall has no corner towers, how can it be a grand sight!

sentences.zh: 先畢其功，余者緩之。

translations.literal: Finish this work first; the rest may wait."
translations.idiomatic: Finish this work first; the rest may wait."

sentences.zh: 」以建新寺，鑄提調、監造三品銀印。

translations.literal: For construction of the new monastery, silver seals of third rank for supervisor and construction overseer were cast.
translations.idiomatic: For construction of the new monastery, silver seals of third rank for supervisor and construction overseer were cast.

sentences.zh: 益都、東平、東昌、濟寧、河間、順德、廣平、大名、汴梁、衛輝、泰安、高唐、曹、濮、德、揚、滁、高郵等處蝗。

translations.literal: Yidu, Dongping, Dongchang, Jining, Hejian, Shunde, Guangping, Daming, Bianliang, Weihui, Tai'an, Gaotang, Cao, Pu, De, Yang, Chu, Gaoyou, and other places suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: Yidu, Dongping, Dongchang, Jining, Hejian, Shunde, Guangping, Daming, Bianliang, Weihui, Tai'an, Gaotang, Cao, Pu, De, Yang, Chu, Gaoyou, and other places suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，以通政院使憨剌合兒知樞密院事，董建興聖宮，令大都留守養安等督其工。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on dinghai day Hanlaher, communications commissioner, was made privy council administrator and put in charge of building the Xingsheng Palace; Dadu resident Yang'an and others were ordered to supervise the work.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on dinghai day Hanlaher, communications commissioner, was made privy council administrator and put in charge of building the Xingsheng Palace; Dadu resident Yang'an and others were ordered to supervise the work.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以陰陽家言，自今至聖誕節不宜興土功，敕權停新寺工役。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, because yin-yang masters said that from now until the Sage's birthday earthworks were inauspicious, an edict temporarily halted corvée on the new monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, because yin-yang masters said that from now until the Sage's birthday earthworks were inauspicious, an edict temporarily halted corvée on the new monastery.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，御史臺臣言：「乘輿北幸，而京師工役正興，加之歲旱乏食，民愚易惑，所關甚重，乞留一丞相鎮京師，後為例。

translations.literal: On jiachen day censorate officials said: "While the imperial carriage travels north, capital corvée is in full swing; moreover drought and food shortage afflict the year — the people are easily misled, and the matter is extremely grave — we request that one chancellor remain to guard the capital, and that this become precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day censorate officials said, "While the imperial carriage travels north, capital corvée is in full swing; moreover drought and food shortage afflict the year — the people are easily misled, and the matter is extremely grave — we request that one chancellor remain to guard the capital, and that this become precedent.

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，選官督捕蝗。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on guihai day officials were selected to supervise locust extermination.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on guihai day officials were selected to supervise locust extermination.

sentences.zh: 從皇太子言，禁諸賜田者馳驛征租擾民。

translations.literal: At the crown prince's word, those granted fields were forbidden to ride relay posts to collect rent and harass the people.
translations.idiomatic: At the crown prince's word, those granted fields were forbidden to ride relay posts to collect rent and harass the people.

sentences.zh: 庚午，中書省臣言：「奉旨既停新寺工役，其亭苑鷹坊諸役，乞並罷。

translations.literal: On gengwu day central secretariat officials said: "Since the order has already halted corvée on the new monastery, the pavilion gardens, falconry offices, and other corvée — we request that all be abolished as well.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day central secretariat officials said, "Since the order has already halted corvée on the new monastery, the pavilion gardens, falconry offices, and other corvée — we request that all be abolished as well.

sentences.zh: 又，太醫院遣使取藥材於陜西、四川、雲南，費公帑，勞驛傳。

translations.literal: Also, the Imperial Medical Academy dispatches envoys to obtain medicinal materials in Shaanxi, Sichuan, and Yunnan, expending public funds and exhausting relay transport.

sentences.zh: 臣等議，事幹錢糧，隔越中書省徑行，乞禁止。

translations.literal: We your ministers consider that matters touching money and grain, bypassing the central secretariat and acting directly — we request that this be forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: We your ministers consider that matters touching money and grain, bypassing the central secretariat and acting directly — we request that this be forbidden."

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: Both approved.

sentences.zh: 以益都、濟南、般陽三路，寧海一州屬宣慰司，余並令直隸省部。

translations.literal: Yidu, Jinan, and Panyang routes and Ninghai Prefecture were placed under the pacification commission; the remainder were all ordered to report directly to the provincial offices.
translations.idiomatic: Yidu, Jinan, and Panyang routes and Ninghai Prefecture were placed under the pacification commission; the remainder were all ordered to report directly to the provincial offices.

sentences.zh: 以大都隸儒籍者四十戶充文廟樂工。

translations.literal: Forty households registered as Confucian scholars in the Great Capital were assigned as temple musicians for the Confucian shrine.
translations.idiomatic: 40 households registered as Confucian scholars in the Great Capital were assigned as temple musicians for the Confucian shrine.

sentences.zh: 從皇太子請，改典樂司提點、大使等官為卿、少卿、丞。

translations.literal: At the crown prince's request, the director, commissioner, and other officials of the Directorate of Music were changed to director, vice director, and assistant director.
translations.idiomatic: At the crown prince's request, the director, commissioner, and other officials of the Directorate of Music were changed to director, vice director, and assistant director.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以宿衛之士比多冗雜，遵舊制，存蒙古、色目之有閥閱者，餘皆革去。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, because palace guards had grown excessively numerous and mixed, following the old system, only Mongols and semuren of distinguished lineage were retained; the rest were all removed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, because palace guards had grown excessively numerous and mixed, following the old system, only Mongols and semuren of distinguished lineage were retained; the rest were all removed.

sentences.zh: 皇太子言：「宣政院先奉旨，毆西番僧者截其手，詈之者斷其舌，此法昔所未聞，有乖國典，且於僧無益。

translations.literal: The crown prince said: "The Xuanzheng Bureau earlier received an order that those who beat Tibetan monks should have their hands cut off and those who revile them their tongues cut out — this law has never been heard of before; it violates the laws of the state and moreover does the monks no good.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince said, "The Xuanzheng Bureau earlier received an order that those who beat Tibetan monks should have their hands cut off and those who revile them their tongues cut out — this law has never been heard of before; it violates the laws of the state and moreover does the monks no good.

sentences.zh: 僧俗相犯，已有明憲，乞更其令。

translations.literal: When monks and laymen offend one another, there are already clear statutes — we request that the order be changed.
translations.idiomatic: When monks and laymen offend one another, there are already clear statutes — we request that the order be changed.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「宣政院文案不檢核，於憲章有礙，遵舊制為宜。

translations.literal: He also said: "The Xuanzheng Bureau does not examine documents — this obstructs the laws and regulations; following the old system would be fitting."
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "The Xuanzheng Bureau does not examine documents — this obstructs the laws and regulations; following the old system would be fitting."

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: Both approved.
translations.idiomatic: Both approved.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，中書省臣言：「河南、江浙省言，宣政院奏免僧、道、也裏可溫、答失蠻租稅。

translations.literal: On yihai day central secretariat officials said: "Henan and Jiang-Zhe provinces report that the Xuanzheng Bureau memorialized exemption of monks, Daoists, Nestorian Christians, and Dashman from land rent and commercial tax.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day central secretariat officials said, "Henan and Jiang-Zhe provinces report that the Xuanzheng Bureau memorialized exemption of monks, Daoists, Nestorian Christians, and Dashman from land rent and commercial tax.

sentences.zh: 臣等議，田有租，商有稅，乃祖宗成法，今宣政院一體奏免，非制。

translations.literal: We your ministers consider that fields pay rent and merchants pay tax — this is the established law of the ancestors; now the Xuanzheng Bureau memorializes blanket exemption — this is not the system.
translations.idiomatic: We your ministers consider that fields pay rent and merchants pay tax — this is the established law of the ancestors; now the Xuanzheng Bureau memorializes blanket exemption — this is not the system.

sentences.zh: 」有旨，依舊制征之。

translations.literal: An order stated that collection should follow the old system.
translations.idiomatic: An order stated that collection should follow the old system.

sentences.zh: 是月，金城、崞州、源州雨雹，延安之神木碾谷、盤西、神川等處大雨雹，霸州、檀州、涿州、良鄉、舒城、歷陽、合肥、六安、江寧、句容、溧水、上元等處蝗。

translations.literal: That month, Jincheng, Guo Prefecture, and Yuan Prefecture suffered rain and hail; Shenmu, Panxi, Shenchuan, and other places in Yan'an suffered heavy hail; Bazhou, Tanzhou, Zhuozhou, Liangxiang, Shucheng, Liyang, Hefei, Lu'an, Jiangning, Jurong, Lishui, Shangyuan, and other places suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jincheng, Guo Prefecture, and Yuan Prefecture suffered rain and hail; Shenmu, Panxi, Shenchuan, and other places in Yan'an suffered heavy hail; Bazhou, Tanzhou, Zhuozhou, Liangxiang, Shucheng, Liyang, Hefei, Lu'an, Jiangning, Jurong, Lishui, Shangyuan, and other places suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，河決歸德府境。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn, on guiwei day the Yellow River burst its banks in Guide Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, autumn, on guiwei day the Yellow River burst its banks in Guide Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，宣政院臣言：「武靖王搠思班與朵思麻宣慰司言：『松潘疊宕威茂州等處安撫司管內，西番、禿魯卜、降胡、漢民四種人雜處，昨遣經歷蔡懋昭往蛇谷隴迷招之，降其八部，戶萬七千，皆數百年負固頑獷之人，酋長令真巴等八人已嘗廷見。

translations.literal: On renchen day Xuanzheng Bureau officials said: "Prince of Wujing Sosban and Duosima, director of the pacification commission, report: 'Within the jurisdiction of the Pacification Commission of Songpan, Diezhang, Weimao Prefecture, and other places, Tibetans, Tuluobu, surrendered Hu, and Han commoners of four kinds of people live mixed together. Recently Commissioner Cai Maozhao was sent to Shegu Longmi to summon them; eight tribes submitted, seventeen thousand households — all people who had stubbornly resisted for centuries; chieftains Lingzhenba and eight others have already had audience at court.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Xuanzheng Bureau officials said, "Prince of Wujing Sosban and Duosima, director of the pacification commission, report, 'Within the jurisdiction of the Pacification Commission of Songpan, Diezhang, Weimao Prefecture, and other places, Tibetans, Tuluobu, surrendered Hu, and Han commoners of four kinds of people live mixed together. Recently Commissioner Cai Maozhao was sent to Shegu Longmi to summon them; eight tribes submitted, 17,000 households — all people who had stubbornly resisted for centuries; chieftains Lingzhenba and eight others have already had audience at court.

sentences.zh: 今令真巴謂其地鄰接四川，未降者尚十餘萬。

translations.literal: Now Lingzhenba says their land adjoins Sichuan, and those not yet submitted still number more than one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Now Lingzhenba says their land adjoins Sichuan, and those not yet submitted still number more than 100,000.

sentences.zh: 宣撫司官皆他郡人，不知蠻夷事宜，才至成都灌州，畏懼即返，何以撫治？

translations.literal: Pacification commission officials are all men from other commanderies and do not understand barbarian affairs; they reach Chengdu and Guan Prefecture and return at once from fear — how can they govern and pacify?
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commission officials are all men from other commanderies and do not understand barbarian affairs; they reach Chengdu and Guan Prefecture and return at once from fear — how can they govern and pacify?

sentences.zh: 宜改安撫司為宣撫司，遷治茂州，徙松州軍千人鎮遏為便。

translations.literal: It would be fitting to change the Pacification Commission to a Pacification Office, relocate its seat to Maozhou, and move one thousand Songzhou troops to garrison and restrain them.'
translations.idiomatic: It would be fitting to change the Pacification Commission to a Pacification Office, relocate its seat to Maozhou, and move 1,000 Songzhou troops to garrison and restrain them.'

sentences.zh: 』臣等議，宜從其言。

translations.literal: ' We your ministers consider that their proposal should be followed.
translations.idiomatic: ' We your ministers consider that their proposal should be followed.

sentences.zh: 」詔改松潘疊宕威茂州安撫司為宣撫司，遷治茂州汶川縣，秩正三品，以八兒思的斤為宣撫司達魯花赤，蔡懋昭為副使，並佩虎符。

translations.literal: An edict changed the Pacification Commission of Songpan, Diezhang, and Weimao Prefecture to a Pacification Office, relocated its seat to Wenchuan County in Maozhou, rank primary third grade; Ba'rsidjin was made darughachi of the Pacification Office, Cai Maozhao vice commissioner — both granted tiger tallies.
translations.idiomatic: An edict changed the Pacification Commission of Songpan, Diezhang, and Weimao Prefecture to a Pacification Office, relocated its seat to Wenchuan County in Maozhou, rank primary third grade; Ba'rsidjin was made darughachi of the Pacification Office, Cai Maozhao vice commissioner — both granted tiger tallies.

sentences.zh: 乙未，復置贛州龍南、安遠二縣。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Longnan and Anyuan counties in Gan Prefecture were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Longnan and Anyuan counties in Gan Prefecture were restored.

sentences.zh: 以河西二十驛往來使多，馬數既少，民力耗竭，命中書省、樞密院、通政院於諸部撥戶增馬以濟之。

translations.literal: Because the twenty relay stations of Hexi saw many passing envoys while horses were few and the people's strength was exhausted, the central secretariat, privy council, and Communications Office were ordered to allocate households from various divisions to increase horses and supply the need.
translations.idiomatic: Because the 20 relay stations of Hexi saw many passing envoys while horses were few and the people's strength was exhausted, the central secretariat, privy council, and Communications Office were ordered to allocate households from various divisions to increase horses and supply the need.

sentences.zh: 樂實言鈔法大壞，請更鈔法，圖新鈔式以進，又與保八議立尚書省，詔與乞臺普濟、塔思不花、赤因鐵木兒、脫虎脫集議以聞。

translations.literal: Leshi said the paper-note system was greatly corrupted and requested reform of the note law; he drew a new note design and presented it, and also with Ba'ba deliberated establishing the Ministry of Revenue; an edict ordered Chigai Puji, Tashihwa, Chiyin Temur, and Toghto to assemble in deliberation and report.
translations.idiomatic: Leshi said the paper-note system was greatly corrupted and requested reform of the note law; he drew a new note design and presented it, and also with Ba'ba deliberated establishing the Ministry of Revenue; an edict ordered Chigai Puji, Tashihwa, Chiyin Temur, and Toghto to assemble in deliberation and report.

sentences.zh: 己亥，河決汴梁之封丘。

translations.literal: On jihai day the Yellow River burst its banks at Fengqiu in Bianliang.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the Yellow River burst its banks at Fengqiu in Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，改昔保赤八剌合孫總管府為奉時院。

translations.literal: On jiachen day the Chief Commandery of Xibaozhibalhesun was changed to the Fengshi Court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Chief Commandery of Xibaozhibalhesun was changed to the Fengshi Court.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，保八言：「臣與塔思不花、乞臺普濟等集議立尚書省事，臣今竊自思之，政事得失，皆前日中書省臣所為，今欲舉正，彼懼有累，孰願行者？

translations.literal: On yisi day Ba'ba said: "Your subject together with Tashihwa, Chigai Puji, and others assembled in deliberation on establishing the Ministry of Revenue; your subject now reflects privately — the gains and losses of government all stem from what the central secretariat officials did the day before; now if we wish to set things right, they fear being implicated — who would be willing to act?
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Ba'ba said, "Your subject together with Tashihwa, Chigai Puji, and others assembled in deliberation on establishing the Ministry of Revenue; your subject now reflects privately — the gains and losses of government all stem from what the central secretariat officials did the day before; now if we wish to set things right, they fear being implicated — who would be willing to act?

sentences.zh: 臣今不言，誠以大事為懼。

translations.literal: If your subject now remains silent, it is truly from fear of great affairs.
translations.idiomatic: If your subject now remains silent, it is truly from fear of great affairs.

sentences.zh: 陛下若矜憐保八、樂實所議，請立尚書省，舊事從中書，新政從尚書。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty would show compassion for what Ba'ba and Leshi propose, we request establishment of the Ministry of Revenue — old affairs handled by the central secretariat, new policies by the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty would show compassion for what Ba'ba and Leshi propose, we request establishment of the Ministry of Revenue — old affairs handled by the central secretariat, new policies by the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 尚書，請以乞臺普濟、脫虎脫為丞相，三寶奴、樂實為平章，保八為右丞，王羆參知政事。

translations.literal: For the Ministry of Revenue, we request Chigai Puji and Toghto as chancellors, Sanbaonu and Leshi as grand councillors, Ba'ba as right vice director, and Wang Pi as associate administrator.
translations.idiomatic: For the Ministry of Revenue, we request Chigai Puji and Toghto as chancellors, Sanbaonu and Leshi as grand councillors, Ba'ba as right vice director, and Wang Pi as associate administrator.

sentences.zh: 姓江者畫鈔式，以為印鈔庫大使。

translations.literal: One Jiang, who drew the note design, is to be made commissioner of the Note Printing Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: One Jiang, who drew the note design, is to be made commissioner of the Note Printing Treasury.

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: Both approved.
translations.idiomatic: Both approved.

sentences.zh: 塔思不花言：「此大事，遽爾更張，乞與老臣更議。

translations.literal: Tashihwa said: "This is a great matter; to change it so abruptly — we request further deliberation with senior ministers."
translations.idiomatic: Tashihwa said, "This is a great matter; to change it so abruptly — we request further deliberation with senior ministers."

sentences.zh: 」帝不從。

translations.literal: The Emperor did not approve.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor did not approve.

sentences.zh: 是月，濟南、濟寧、般陽、曹、濮、德、高唐、河中、解、絳、耀、同、華等州蝗。

translations.literal: That month, Jinan, Jining, Panyang, Cao, Pu, De, Gaotang, Hezhong, Jie, Jiang, Yao, Tong, and Hua prefectures suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jinan, Jining, Panyang, Cao, Pu, De, Gaotang, Hezhong, Jie, Jiang, Yao, Tong, and Hua prefectures suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，中書省臣言：「甘肅省僻在邊垂，城中蓄金谷以給諸王軍馬，世祖、成宗嘗修其城池。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on renzi day central secretariat officials said: "Gansu Province lies remote on the frontier; within the city gold and grain are stored to supply princes' armies and horses — Shizu and Chengzong both repaired its walls.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on renzi day central secretariat officials said, "Gansu Province lies remote on the frontier; within the city gold and grain are stored to supply princes' armies and horses — Shizu and Chengzong both repaired its walls.

sentences.zh: 近撒的迷失擅興兵甲，掠豳王出伯輜重，民大驚擾。

translations.literal: Recently Sadishimi on his own authority raised troops and armor, plundered Prince of Bin Chubei's baggage train, and the people were greatly alarmed and disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Sadishimi on his own authority raised troops and armor, plundered Prince of Bin Chubei's baggage train, and the people were greatly alarmed and disturbed.

sentences.zh: 今撒的迷失已伏誅，其城若不修，慮啟寇心。

translations.literal: Now that Sadishimi has been executed, if the city is not repaired, we fear it will embolden bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Sadishimi has been executed, if the city is not repaired, we fear it will embolden bandits.

sentences.zh: 又，沙、瓜州摘軍屯田，歲入糧二萬五千石，撒的迷失叛，不令其軍入屯，遂廢。

translations.literal: Moreover, garrison troops were withdrawn from Shazhou and Guazhou for colony farming, yielding twenty-five thousand shi of grain annually; when Sadishimi rebelled he did not permit the troops to enter the colonies, and they were abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, garrison troops were withdrawn from Shazhou and Guazhou for colony farming, yielding 25,000 shi of grain annually; when Sadishimi rebelled he did not permit the troops to enter the colonies, and they were abandoned.

sentences.zh: 今乞仍舊遣軍屯種，選知屯田地利色目、漢人各一員領之。

translations.literal: We now request that troops again be sent to colonize and plant as before, selecting one Semuren and one Han official each who know the colony lands to lead them.
translations.idiomatic: We now request that troops again be sent to colonize and plant as before, selecting one Semuren and one Han official each who know the colony lands to lead them.

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: " All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

translations.literal: On guichou day the Ministry of Revenue was established; Qitai Puji was made grand preceptor and right chancellor, Toghto left chancellor, Sanbaonu and Yeshi grand councillors, Baoba right vice chancellor, Mangqutuemur left vice chancellor, Wang Pi associate administrator; Central Secretariat Left Vice Chancellor Liu Ji was appointed left vice chancellor of the Ministry of Revenue and deliberator of Ministry of Revenue affairs; an edict was proclaimed to all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the Ministry of Revenue was established; Qitai Puji was made grand preceptor and right chancellor, Toghto left chancellor, Sanbaonu and Yeshi grand councillors, Baoba right vice chancellor, Mangqutuemur left vice chancellor, Wang Pi associate administrator; central secretariat left vice chancellor Liu Ji was appointed left vice chancellor of the Ministry of Revenue and deliberator of Ministry of Revenue affairs; an edict was proclaimed to all under heaven.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，敕以海剌孫昔與伯顏、阿術平江南，知兵事，可授平章政事，商議樞密院事。

translations.literal: On jiayin day an edict stated: because Halaqsun once joined Bayan and Aji in pacifying Jiangnan and understands military affairs, he may be appointed grand councillor and deliberator of privy council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict stated: because Halaqsun once joined Bayan and Aji in pacifying Jiangnan and understands military affairs, he may be appointed grand councillor and deliberator of privy council affairs.

sentences.zh: 以阿速衛軍五百人隸諸王怯裏不花，駐和林，給鈔萬五千錠，人備四馬。

translations.literal: Five hundred Asud guard troops were placed under Prince Qieli Buhua, stationed at Karakorum; fifteen thousand ingots of notes were granted, and each man was supplied with four horses.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred Asud guard troops were placed under Prince Qieli Buhua, stationed at Karakorum; 15,000 ingots of notes were granted, and each man was supplied with four horses.

sentences.zh: 己未，立皇太子右衛率府，秩正三品，命尚書右丞相脫虎脫、御史大夫不裏牙敦並領右衛率府事。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the crown prince's Right Guard Rate Office was established, rank upper third grade; Right Chancellor of the Ministry of Revenue Toghto and Censor-in-Chief Buliyadun were both ordered to head Right Guard Rate Office affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the crown prince's Right Guard Rate Office was established, rank upper third grade; right chancellor of the Ministry of Revenue Toghto and censor-in-chief Buliyadun were both ordered to head Right Guard Rate Office affairs.

sentences.zh: 尚書省臣言：「中書省尚有逋欠錢糧應追理者，宜存斷事官十人，餘皆並入尚書省。

translations.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials said: "The central secretariat still has outstanding money and grain that should be pursued and settled; ten judicial officers should be retained, and the remainder all merged into the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials said, "The central secretariat still has outstanding money and grain that should be pursued and settled; ten judicial officers should be retained, and the remainder all merged into the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「往者大辟獄具，尚書省議定，令中書省裁酌以聞，宜依舊制。

translations.literal: " They also said: "Formerly, when capital cases were fully tried, the Ministry of Revenue deliberated and fixed them, then the central secretariat weighed and reported — the old system should be followed.
translations.idiomatic: " They also said, "Formerly, when capital cases were fully tried, the Ministry of Revenue deliberated and fixed them, then the central secretariat weighed and reported — the old system should be followed.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 以江西等處行中書省參知政事郝彬為尚書省參知政事。

translations.literal: Hao Bin, associate administrator of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, was made associate administrator of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Bin, associate administrator of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, was made associate administrator of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賜太師𠇗頭名脫兒赤顏。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the name Tuerchiyan was granted to Grand Preceptor Botou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the name Tuerchiyan was granted to grand preceptor Botou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，永平路隕霜殺禾。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Yongping Circuit suffered frost that killed the grain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Yongping Circuit suffered frost that killed the grain.

sentences.zh: 己卯，三寶奴言：「尚書省立，更新庶政，變易鈔法，用官六十四員，其中宿衛之士有之，品秩未至者有之，未歷仕者有之。

translations.literal: On jimao day Sanbaonu said: "With the Ministry of Revenue established, renewing all government, changing the note system, sixty-four officials are employed; among them are imperial guard soldiers, some whose rank is not yet sufficient, some who have never held office.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Sanbaonu said, "With the Ministry of Revenue established, renewing all government, changing the note system, 64 officials are employed; among them are imperial guard soldiers, some whose rank is not yet sufficient, some who have never held office.

sentences.zh: 此皆素習於事，既已任之，乞勿拘例，授以宣敕。

translations.literal: These are all habitually skilled in affairs; since they have already been appointed, we request they not be bound by precedent and be granted commission edicts.
translations.idiomatic: These are all habitually skilled in affairs; since they have already been appointed, we request they not be bound by precedent and be granted commission edicts.

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

translations.literal: An edict proclaimed to all under heaven: whoever dares obstruct Ministry of Revenue affairs shall be punished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict proclaimed to all under heaven: whoever dares obstruct Ministry of Revenue affairs shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 真定、保定、河間、順德、廣平、彰德、大名、衛輝、懷孟、汴梁等處蝗。

translations.literal: Zhending, Baoding, Hejian, Shunde, Guangping, Zhangde, Daming, Weihui, Huaimeng, Kaifeng, and other places suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰朔，以尚書省條畫詔天下，改各行中書省為行尚書省。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengchen new moon: by the Ministry of Revenue's comprehensive regulations an edict was sent to all under heaven; each branch central secretariat was changed to a branch Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengchen new moon, by the Ministry of Revenue's comprehensive regulations an edict was sent to all under heaven; each branch central secretariat was changed to a branch Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 詔：「朝廷得失，軍民利害，臣民有上言者，皆得實封上聞，在外者赴所屬轉達。

translations.idiomatic: An edict stated, "Gains and losses of the court, benefits and harms to army and people — if ministers or commoners have proposals, all may submit sealed memorials to the throne; those outside submit through their superiors for forwarding.

sentences.zh: 各處人民，饑荒轉徙復業者，一切逋欠，並行蠲免，仍除差稅三年。

translations.literal: People everywhere who return to their occupations after fleeing famine — all outstanding debts shall be remitted, and corvée levies waived for three years.

sentences.zh: 田野死亡，遺骸暴露，官為收拾。

translations.literal: Where bodies lie dead in the fields and bones lie exposed, the government shall collect and bury them.
translations.idiomatic: Where bodies lie dead in the fields and bones lie exposed, the government shall collect and bury them.

sentences.zh: 」頒行至大銀鈔，詔曰：「昔我世祖皇帝既登大寶，始造中統交鈔，以便民用，歲久法隳，亦既更張，印造至元寶鈔。

translations.literal: " Zhidai silver notes were issued; the edict said: "In the past, after Our Taizu Emperor ascended the great throne, he first created Zhongtong paper notes for the people's convenience; years passed and the law decayed, and it was already reformed with the printing of Zhiyuan treasure notes.

sentences.zh: 至大銀鈔一兩，準至元鈔五貫、白銀一兩、赤金一錢。

translations.literal: One liang of Zhidai silver notes equals five guan of Zhiyuan notes, one liang of white silver, and one qian of red gold.
translations.idiomatic: One liang of Zhidai silver notes equals five guan of Zhiyuan notes, one liang of white silver, and one qian of red gold.

sentences.zh: 隨路立平準行用庫，買賣金銀，倒換昏鈔。

translations.literal: Market stabilization exchange treasuries were established in every route to buy and sell gold and silver and exchange worn notes.
translations.idiomatic: Market stabilization exchange treasuries were established in every route to buy and sell gold and silver and exchange worn notes.

sentences.zh: 或民間絲綿布帛，赴庫回易，依驗時估給價。

translations.literal: Or when the people bring silk, cotton, cloth, and silk to the treasury for exchange, price is given according to current estimates.
translations.idiomatic: Or when the people bring silk, cotton, cloth, and silk to the treasury for exchange, price is given according to current estimates.

sentences.zh: 隨處路府州縣，設立常平倉以權物價，豐年收糴粟麥米谷，值青黃不接之時，比附時估，減價出糶，以遏沸湧。

translations.literal: In every prefecture, route, and county ever-normal granaries were set up to stabilize prices; in good years grain, wheat, rice, and millet are purchased and stored; when green and yellow do not connect, they are sold out at reduced prices compared with current estimates to check soaring prices.
translations.idiomatic: In every prefecture, route, and county ever-normal granaries were set up to stabilize prices; in good years grain, wheat, rice, and millet are purchased and stored; when green and yellow do not connect, they are sold out at reduced prices compared with current estimates to check soaring prices.

sentences.zh: 金銀私相買賣及海舶興販金、銀、銅錢、綿絲、布帛下海者，並禁之。

translations.literal: Private buying and selling of gold and silver, and shipping gold, silver, copper cash, cotton, silk, and cloth overseas by sea vessels, are all forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Private buying and selling of gold and silver, and shipping gold, silver, copper cash, cotton, silk, and cloth overseas by sea vessels, are all forbidden.

sentences.zh: 平準行用庫、常平倉設官，皆於流官內銓註，以二年為滿。

translations.literal: Officials for market stabilization exchange treasuries and ever-normal granaries are all selected from regular officials, with two-year terms.
translations.idiomatic: Officials for market stabilization exchange treasuries and ever-normal granaries are all selected from regular officials, with two-year terms.

sentences.zh: 中統交鈔，詔書到日，限一百日盡數赴庫倒換。

translations.literal: For Zhongtong exchange notes, from the day the edict arrives, within one hundred days all must be taken to the treasury for exchange.
translations.idiomatic: For Zhongtong exchange notes, from the day the edict arrives, within 100 days all must be taken to the treasury for exchange.

sentences.zh: 茶、鹽、酒、醋、商稅諸色課程，如收至大銀鈔，以一當五。

translations.literal: For tea, salt, wine, vinegar, commercial taxes, and other assorted levies, if Zhidai silver notes are collected, one counts as five.
translations.idiomatic: For tea, salt, wine, vinegar, commercial taxes, and other assorted levies, if Zhidai silver notes are collected, one counts as five.

sentences.zh: 頒行至大銀鈔二兩至一厘，定為一十三等，以便民用。

translations.literal: Zhidai silver notes from two liang down to one li were issued, fixed at thirteen denominations for the people's convenience.
translations.idiomatic: Zhidai silver notes from two liang down to one li were issued, fixed at 13 denominations for the people's convenience.

translations.literal: On guwei day Ministry of Revenue officials said: "In antiquity offices were established and duties divided, each with its charge; today the land is vast and the people numerous, affairs ever more complex — if provincial ministers grasp the overall lead and the various officials each fulfill their duties, how could affairs go ungoverned?

sentences.zh: 頃歲省務壅塞，朝夕惟署押文案，事皆廢弛。

translations.literal: In recent years provincial affairs blocked up; morning and evening only affixing and sealing documents — affairs all fell into neglect.

translations.idiomatic: Heavenly disaster and the people's hardship spring from this.

translations.literal: From now on, for all Ministry and provincial affairs, all are ordered handled as circumstances permit; major matters that require memorializing may do so after receiving instruction, then act — thereby achieving utmost governance, obeying heaven's way above and settling the people's hearts below.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, for all Ministry and provincial affairs, all are ordered handled as circumstances permit; major matters that require memorializing may do so after receiving instruction, then act — thereby achieving utmost governance, obeying heaven's way above and settling the people's hearts below.

translations.literal: Regulations of successive reigns differed front and back; enforcing officials arbitrarily weighted light and heavy — we request that from Taizu onward the nine thousand-odd administrative orders issued be culled of redundancy to unify them, compiled as fixed regulation.

translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the imperial carriage reached Dadu.

translations.literal: On wuzi day Ministry of Revenue officials said: "At the Hanlin Imperial History Academy, prior reigns' imperial portraits and veritable records are all kept there — it was formerly placed at the southern secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Ministry of Revenue officials said, "At the Hanlin Imperial History Academy, prior reigns' imperial portraits and veritable records are all kept there — it was formerly placed at the southern secretariat.

translations.idiomatic: Approved.

translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Prince of Gaotang Zhuan was granted 5,000 liang of gold and 50,000 liang of silver.

translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day censorate officials said, "In recent years harvest failed and pestilence afflicted the people; Your Majesty in pity relieved them — those who were saved are many.

translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the moon encroached upon Shen.

sentences.zh: 尚書省臣言：「鹽價每引宜增為至大銀鈔四兩，廣西者如故，其煮鹽工本，請增為至大銀鈔四錢。

translations.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials said: "The salt price per yin should be raised to four liang of Zhi-da silver notes; Guangxi's remains as before; the cost of salt-boiling labor — we request raising it to four qian of Zhi-da silver notes.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials said, "The salt price per yin should be raised to four liang of Zhi-da silver notes; Guangxi's remains as before; the cost of salt-boiling labor — we request raising it to four qian of Zhi-da silver notes.

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，申禁漢人執弓矢、兵仗。

translations.literal: On xinyou day the prohibition on Han people carrying bows, arrows, and weapons was reiterated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the prohibition on Han people carrying bows, arrows, and weapons was reiterated.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，陽曲縣地震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On renxu day Yangqu County suffered earthquake, with sounds like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Yangqu County suffered earthquake, with sounds like thunder.

sentences.zh: 封西僧迷不韻子為寧國公，賜金印。

translations.literal: The Western monk Mibuyunzi was enfeoffed as Duke of Ning State and granted a gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: The Western monk Mibuyunzi was enfeoffed as Duke of Ning State and granted a gold seal.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔：「增百官俸，定流官封贈等第。

translations.literal: On dingchou day an edict declared: "Official salaries are to be increased; grades for posthumous enfeoffment of civil officials are to be fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict declared, "Official salaries are to be increased; grades for posthumous enfeoffment of civil officials are to be fixed.

sentences.zh: 應封贈者，或使遠死節，臨陣死事，於見授散官上加之。

translations.literal: For those eligible for enfeoffment — envoys who die maintaining integrity in distant service, or who die in battle — add upon their currently conferred provisional rank.
translations.idiomatic: For those eligible for enfeoffment — envoys who die maintaining integrity in distant service, or who die in battle — add upon their currently conferred provisional rank.

sentences.zh: 若六品七品死節死事者，驗事特贈官。

translations.literal: If rank-six or rank-seven officials die maintaining integrity or in battle, verify the facts and specially confer rank.
translations.idiomatic: If rank-six or rank-seven officials die maintaining integrity or in battle, verify the facts and specially confer rank.

sentences.zh: 封贈內外百官，三品以上者許請謚。

translations.literal: For enfeoffment of inner and outer officials of all ranks, those of third rank and above may petition for posthumous epithets.
translations.idiomatic: For enfeoffment of inner and outer officials of all ranks, those of third rank and above may petition for posthumous epithets.

sentences.zh: 凡請謚者，許其家具本官平日勛勞、政績、德業、藝能，經由所在官司保勘，與本家所供相同，轉申吏部考覆呈都省，都省準擬，令太常禮儀院驗事跡定謚。

translations.literal: For all who petition epithets, permit their families to submit this official's usual meritorious labors, administrative achievements, virtue and conduct, and talents; local offices verify and compare with the family's submission; report through the Ministry of Personnel for review and presentation to the metropolitan secretariat; the metropolitan secretariat approves; the Directorate of Sacrificial Rites verifies deeds and fixes the epithet.
translations.idiomatic: For all who petition epithets, permit their families to submit this official's usual meritorious labors, administrative achievements, virtue and conduct, and talents; local offices verify and compare with the family's submission; report through the Ministry of Personnel for review and presentation to the metropolitan secretariat; the metropolitan secretariat approves; the Directorate of Sacrificial Rites verifies deeds and fixes the epithet.

sentences.zh: 若勛戚大臣奉旨賜謚者，不在此例。」

translations.literal: If meritorious kin and great ministers receive epithets by special imperial order, they are not within this rule."
translations.idiomatic: If meritorious kin and great ministers receive epithets by special imperial order, they are not within this rule."

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸未，省中書官吏，自客省使而下一百八十一員。

translations.literal: Year 3, spring, first month, guiwei day: central secretariat officials were reduced — from guest-reception commissioner downward, one hundred eighty-one posts.
translations.idiomatic: Year 3, spring, first month, guiwei day: central secretariat officials were reduced — from guest-reception commissioner downward, 181 posts.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王那木忽裏等鈔萬二千錠，賜宣徽院使拙忽難所隸酒人鈔萬五百八十八錠。

translations.literal: Princes Namuhuli and others were granted twelve thousand ingots of notes; wine merchants under Xuanzheng Bureau commissioner Zhuohunan were granted ten thousand five hundred eighty-eight ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Namuhuli and others were granted 12,000 ingots of notes; wine merchants under Xuanzheng Bureau commissioner Zhuohunan were granted 10,588 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，特授李孟榮祿大夫、平章政事、集賢大學士、同知徽政院事。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Li Meng was specially appointed Glory-and-Salary Grand Master, grand councillor, Hanlin Academician Exemplar, and associate director of the Palace Domestic Service Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Li Meng was specially appointed Glory-and-Salary Grand Master, grand councillor, Hanlin Academician Exemplar, and associate director of the Palace Domestic Service Bureau.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On dinghai day a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 戊子，禁近侍諸人外增課額及進他物有妨經制。

translations.literal: On wuzi day it was prohibited for inner attendants to increase tax quotas externally or present other items contrary to established regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day it was prohibited for inner attendants to increase tax quotas externally or present other items contrary to established regulations.

sentences.zh: 營五臺寺，役工匠千四百人、軍三千五百人。

translations.literal: Wutai Monastery was constructed, employing one thousand four hundred artisans and three thousand five hundred soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Wutai Monastery was constructed, employing 1,400 artisans and 3,500 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以紐鄰參議尚書省事。

translations.literal: On jichou day Niulin was made deliberator on Ministry of Revenue affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Niulin was made deliberator on Ministry of Revenue affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，立司禋監，秩正三品，掌巫覡，以丞相厘日領之。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the Directorate of State Sacrifice was established at upper third grade, in charge of shamans and diviners; the chancellor supervised daily affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Directorate of State Sacrifice was established at upper third grade, in charge of shamans and diviners; the chancellor supervised daily affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，立皇后弘吉列氏，遣脫虎脫攝太尉持節授玉冊、玉寶。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Empress Hongjilie was installed; Toghto was dispatched as acting Grand Captain bearing credentials to confer the jade book and jade seal.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Empress Hongjilie was installed; Toghto was dispatched as acting grand captain bearing credentials to confer the jade book and jade seal.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，升中政院為從一品。

translations.literal: On renchen day the Palace Domestic Service Bureau was raised to first sub-rank.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the Palace Domestic Service Bureau was raised to first sub-rank.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，立中瑞司，秩正三品，掌皇后寶。

translations.literal: On guisi day the Central Auspicious Bureau was established at upper third grade, in charge of the empress's seals.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the Central Auspicious Bureau was established at upper third grade, in charge of the empress's seals.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太陰犯右執法。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the moon encroached upon the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the moon encroached upon the Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 乙未，定稅課法，諸色課程，並系大德十一年考較，定舊額、元增，總為正額，折至元鈔作數。

translations.literal: On yiwei day the tax-assessment law was fixed; all categories of revenue quotas were calculated from Dade year 11, fixing old quotas and original increases as the standard quota, converted to Zhiyuan note amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the tax-assessment law was fixed; all categories of revenue quotas were calculated from Dade year 11, fixing old quotas and original increases as the standard quota, converted to Zhiyuan note amounts.

sentences.zh: 自至大三年為始恢辦，余止以十分為率，增及三分以上為下酬，五分以上為中酬，七分以上為上酬，增及九分為最，不及三分為殿。

translations.literal: From Zhi-da year 3 restoration began; beyond that only a ten-percent rate applied — increase of three parts or more counted as lower reward; five parts or more as middle reward; seven parts or more as upper reward; increase of nine parts as highest; less than three parts as lowest.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhi-da year 3 restoration began; beyond that only a ten-percent rate applied — increase of three parts or more counted as lower reward; five parts or more as middle reward; seven parts or more as upper reward; increase of nine parts as highest; less than three parts as lowest.

sentences.zh: 所設資品官員，以二周歲為滿。

translations.literal: Established quota-rank officials served two-year terms.
translations.idiomatic: Established quota-rank officials served two-year terms.

sentences.zh: 定稅課官等第，萬錠之上，設正提舉、同提舉、副提舉各一員；

translations.literal: Tax-assessment official grades were fixed: above ten thousand ingots — one chief intendant, one associate intendant, and one vice intendant each;
translations.idiomatic: Tax-assessment official grades were fixed: above 10,000 ingots — one chief intendant, one associate intendant, and one vice intendant each;

sentences.zh: 一千錠之上，設提領、大使、副使各二員；

translations.literal: Above one thousand ingots — two superintendents, two commissioners, and two vice commissioners each;
translations.idiomatic: Above 1,000 ingots — two superintendents, two commissioners, and two vice commissioners each;

sentences.zh: 五百錠之上，設提領、大使、副使各一員；

translations.literal: Above five hundred ingots — one superintendent, one commissioner, and one vice commissioner each;
translations.idiomatic: Above 500 ingots — one superintendent, one commissioner, and one vice commissioner each;

sentences.zh: 一百錠之上，設大使、副使各一員。

translations.literal: Above one hundred ingots — one commissioner and one vice commissioner each.
translations.idiomatic: Above 100 ingots — one commissioner and one vice commissioner each.

sentences.zh: 丙申，立資國院泉貨監，命以歷代銅錢與至大錢相參行用。

translations.literal: On bingshen day the Capital Resources Bureau and Currency Directorate were established; dynastic copper cash and Zhi-da cash were ordered to circulate together.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Capital Resources Bureau and Currency Directorate were established; dynastic copper cash and Zhi-da cash were ordered to circulate together.

sentences.zh: 復立廣平順德路鐵冶都提舉司。

translations.literal: The Guangping Shunde Route Ironworks Chief Intendant Office was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangping Shunde Route Ironworks Chief Intendant Office was re-established.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔湖廣行省招諭叛人上思州知州黃勝許。

translations.literal: On wuxu day an edict ordered Huguang Province to win over the rebel Shangsi Prefecture prefect Huang Shengxu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day an edict ordered Huguang Province to win over the rebel Shangsi Prefecture prefect Huang Shengxu.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，降詔招諭大徹裏、小徹裏。

translations.literal: On xinchou day an edict was issued to win over Greater Chelì and Lesser Chelì.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day an edict was issued to win over Greater Chelì and Lesser Chelì.

sentences.zh: 樞密院臣言：「湖廣省乖西帶蠻阿馬等連結萬人入寇，已遣萬戶移剌四奴領軍千人，及調思、播土兵並力討捕。

translations.literal: Privy Council officials said: "Guai Xidai Man tribesmen Amma and others joined ten thousand men to invade; Ten-Thousand Household Yelü Sinu has already been dispatched leading one thousand troops, and Si and Bo native troops are being mobilized to jointly suppress and capture.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council officials said, "Guai Xidai Man tribesmen Amma and others joined 10,000 men to invade; Ten-Thousand Household Yelü Sinu has already been dispatched leading 1,000 troops, and Si and Bo native troops are being mobilized to jointly suppress and capture.

sentences.zh: 臣等議，事勢緩急，地裏要害，四奴備知，乞聽其便宜調遣。

translations.literal: We deliberated — the urgency of affairs and key points of the terrain Sinu knows thoroughly; we request he be permitted discretionary deployment.
translations.idiomatic: We deliberated — the urgency of affairs and key points of the terrain Sinu knows thoroughly; we request he be permitted discretionary deployment.

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔諭八百媳婦，遣雲南行省右丞算只兒威招撫之。

translations.literal: On renyin day an edict addressed the Eight Hundred Wives; Yunnan Province right vice censor Sanzhierwei was dispatched to win them over.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict addressed the Eight Hundred Wives; Yunnan Province right vice censor Sanzhierwei was dispatched to win them over.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，改太子少詹事為副詹事。

translations.literal: On guimao day the crown prince's junior household tutor was changed to vice household tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the crown prince's junior household tutor was changed to vice household tutor.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，令中書省官吏如安童居中書時例存設，其已汰者，尚書省遷敘。

translations.literal: On yisi day central secretariat officials were ordered retained at the quota established when Antong headed the secretariat; those already eliminated were reassigned ranks by the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day central secretariat officials were ordered retained at the quota established when Antong headed the secretariat; those already eliminated were reassigned ranks by the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 省樞密院官，存知樞密院七員、同知樞密院事二員、樞密副使二員、僉樞密院事二員、同僉樞密院事一員。

translations.literal: Privy council posts were reduced — seven privy councillors, two associate privy councillors, two privy council vice marshals, two privy council associate administrators, and one privy council junior associate administrator retained.
translations.idiomatic: Privy council posts were reduced — seven privy councillors, two associate privy councillors, two privy council vice marshals, two privy council associate administrators, and one privy council junior associate administrator retained.

sentences.zh: 增御史臺官二員，御史大夫、御史中丞、侍御史、治書侍御史各二員。

translations.literal: Two censorate posts were added; censor-in-chief, censor commissioner, attending censor, and investigating censor — two each.
translations.idiomatic: Two censorate posts were added; censor-in-chief, censor commissioner, attending censor, and investigating censor — two each.

sentences.zh: 省通政院官六員，存十二員。

translations.literal: Transmission Bureau posts were reduced by six; twelve retained.
translations.idiomatic: Transmission Bureau posts were reduced by six; 12 retained.

sentences.zh: 汰廣武康裏衛軍，非其種者還之元籍，凡隸諸王阿只吉、火郎撒及迤南探馬赤者，令樞密院遣人即其處參定為籍。

translations.literal: Guangwukangli guard troops were culled; those not of their breed were returned to original registration; all subordinate to Princes Ajiji, Huolangsa, and the southern tammachi — the privy council was ordered to dispatch men on the spot to fix the registers.
translations.idiomatic: Guangwukangli guard troops were culled; those not of their breed were returned to original registration; all subordinate to Princes Ajiji, Huolangsa, and the southern tammachi — the privy council was ordered to dispatch men on the spot to fix the registers.

sentences.zh: 去歲朝會，諸王伯鐵木兒、阿剌鐵木兒並賜金二百五十兩、銀一千兩、鈔四百錠。

translations.literal: At last year's court assembly Princes Botiemuer and Alatiemuer were each granted two hundred fifty liang of gold, one thousand liang of silver, and four hundred ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: At last year's court assembly Princes Botiemuer and Alatiemuer were each granted 250 liang of gold, 1,000 liang of silver, and 400 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔令知樞密院事大都、僉院合剌合孫復職。

translations.literal: On bingwu day an edict ordered privy councillors Dadu and Heleqhesun to resume their posts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day an edict ordered privy councillors Dadu and Heleqhesun to resume their posts.

sentences.zh: 丁未，立右衛阿速親軍都指揮使司，秩正三品。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the Right Guard Asud Private Army Command was established at upper third grade.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Right Guard Asud Private Army Command was established at upper third grade.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，以皇后受冊，遣官告謝太廟。

translations.literal: Second month, gengxu day: because the empress received the investiture book, envoys were dispatched to announce thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, gengxu day: because the empress received the investiture book, envoys were dispatched to announce thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，熒惑犯月星。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Mars transgressed the Moon.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Mars transgressed the Moon.

sentences.zh: 賜鷹坊馬速忽金百兩、銀五百兩。

translations.literal: The falconry bureau Masuhu was granted one hundred liang of gold and five hundred liang of silver.
translations.idiomatic: The falconry bureau Masuhu was granted 100 liang of gold and 500 liang of silver.

sentences.zh: 己未，浚會通河，給鈔四千八百錠、糧二萬一千石以募民，命河南省平章政事塔失海牙董其役。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the Hui-Tong Canal was dredged; four thousand eight hundred ingots of notes and twenty-one thousand shi of grain were granted to recruit laborers; Henan Province grand councillor Tashihaiya was ordered to supervise the project.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the Hui-Tong Canal was dredged; 4,800 ingots of notes and 21,000 shi of grain were granted to recruit laborers; Henan Province grand councillor Tashihaiya was ordered to supervise the project.

sentences.zh: 遣商議尚書省事劉楫整治鈔法。

translations.literal: Deliberator on Ministry of Revenue affairs Liu Ji was dispatched to rectify the note system.
translations.idiomatic: Deliberator on Ministry of Revenue affairs Liu Ji was dispatched to rectify the note system.

sentences.zh: 增大都警巡院二，分治四隅。

translations.literal: Two Dadu patrol courts were added, each governing one quadrant.
translations.idiomatic: Two Dadu patrol courts were added, each governing one quadrant.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太陰犯左執法。

translations.literal: On renxu day the moon encroached upon the Left Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the moon encroached upon the Left Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以上皇太后尊號，告祀南郊。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, because of the empress dowager's honorific title, announcement sacrifice was performed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, because of the empress dowager's honorific title, announcement sacrifice was performed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，復以僉樞密院事賈鈞為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: On yichou day Jia Jun, associate privy council administrator, was again made associate administrator of the central secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Jia Jun, associate privy council administrator, was again made associate administrator of the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 尚書省臣言：「官階差等，已有定制，近奉聖旨、懿旨、令旨要索官階者，率多躐等，願依世祖皇帝舊制，次第給之。

translations.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials said: "Official rank grades already have fixed regulations; recently those seeking ranks by supreme edict, empress edict, or princess edict often skip grades; we wish to follow Emperor Shizu's old system and grant them in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials said, "Official rank grades already have fixed regulations; recently those seeking ranks by supreme edict, empress edict, or princess edict often skip grades; we wish to follow Emperor Shizu's old system and grant them in sequence.

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，尚書省臣言：「昔至元鈔初行，即以中統鈔本供億及銷其板。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Ministry of Revenue officials said: "When Zhiyuan notes were first issued, Zhongtong note reserves supplied expenses and their blocks were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Ministry of Revenue officials said, "When Zhiyuan notes were first issued, Zhongtong note reserves supplied expenses and their blocks were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 今既行至大銀鈔，乞以至元鈔輸萬億庫，銷毀其板，止以至大鈔與銅錢相權通行為便。

translations.literal: Now that Zhi-da silver notes are being issued, we request Zhiyuan notes be deposited in the Myriad-Estates Treasury, their blocks destroyed — only Zhi-da notes and copper cash circulating together by equivalent weight would be expedient.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Zhi-da silver notes are being issued, we request Zhiyuan notes be deposited in the Myriad-Estates Treasury, their blocks destroyed — only Zhi-da notes and copper cash circulating together by equivalent weight would be expedient.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「今夏朝會上都供億，請先發鈔百萬錠以往。

translations.literal: They also said: "For this summer's court assembly at Shangdu's provisioning, we request one million ingots of notes be issued in advance."
translations.idiomatic: They also said, "For this summer's court assembly at Shangdu's provisioning, we request 1 million ingots of notes be issued in advance."

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: Both were approved.
translations.idiomatic: Both were approved.

sentences.zh: 楚王牙忽都所隸戶貧乏，以米萬石、鈔六千錠賑之。

translations.literal: The registered households under Prince of Chu Yahu were impoverished; ten thousand shi of rice and six thousand ingots of notes were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The registered households under Prince of Chu Yahu were impoverished; 10,000 shi of rice and 6,000 ingots of notes were granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 己巳，寧王闊闊出謀為不軌，越王禿剌子阿剌納失裏許助力，事覺，闊闊出下獄，賜其妻完者死，竄阿剌納失裏及其祖母、母、妻於伯鐵木兒所。

translations.literal: On jisi day Prince of Ning Kuokuochu plotted sedition; Prince of Yue Tula's son Alana Shili promised to assist; when the plot was discovered, Kuokuochu was imprisoned; his wife Wanji was granted death; Alana Shili together with his grandmother, mother, and wife were banished to Botemür's custody.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Prince of Ning Kuokuochu plotted sedition; Prince of Yue Tula's son Alana Shili promised to assist; when the plot was discovered, Kuokuochu was imprisoned; his wife Wanji was granted death; Alana Shili together with his grandmother, mother, and wife were banished to Botemür's custody.

sentences.zh: 以畏吾兒僧鐵裏等二十四人同謀，或知謀不首，並磔於市；

translations.literal: Because twenty-four persons including the Uighur monk Tieli had conspired together, or knew of the plot yet did not report it, all were dismembered in the marketplace;
translations.idiomatic: Because 24 persons including the Uighur monk Tieli had conspired together, or knew of the plot yet did not report it, all were dismembered in the marketplace;

sentences.zh: 鞫其獄者，並升秩二等。

translations.literal: those who tried the case were all promoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: those who tried the case were all promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 賞牙忽都金千兩、銀七千五百兩。

translations.literal: Yahu was rewarded with one thousand taels of gold and seven thousand five hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Yahu was rewarded with 1,000 taels of gold and 7,500 taels of silver.
