translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Prince Mubala's son Maiju Han was enfeoffed Prince of Yan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，晉王也孫鐵木兒言：「世祖以張鐵木兒所獻地土、金銀、銅冶賜臣，後以成宗拘收諸王所占地土民戶，例輸縣官，乞回賜。

translations.literal: On renshen day Prince of Jin Yesun Temuer said: "Shizu granted me the land, gold and silver, and copper smelters that Zhang Temuer presented; later Chengzong confiscated lands and households occupied by princes, with levies paid to county officials — we beg they be returned.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Prince of Jin Yesun Temuer said, "Shizu granted me the land, gold and silver, and copper smelters that Zhang Temuer presented; later Chengzong confiscated lands and households occupied by princes, with levies paid to county officials — we beg they be returned.

sentences.zh: 」從之，仍賜鈔三千錠賑其部貧民。

translations.literal: " Approved; two thousand ingots of notes were also granted to relieve his following's poor.
translations.idiomatic: Approved; 2,000 ingots of notes were also granted to relieve his following's poor.

sentences.zh: 江浙省臣言：「曩者朱清、張<王宣>海漕米歲四五十萬至百十萬，時船多糧少，顧直均平。

translations.literal: Jiang-Zhe provincial officials said: "Formerly Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan's sea-transport grain was four hundred to five hundred thousand up to one million one hundred thousand per year; then ships were many and grain few, so hire costs were evenly fair.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe provincial officials said, "Formerly Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan's sea-transport grain was 400,000 to 500,000 up to 1,100,000 per year; then ships were many and grain few, so hire costs were evenly fair.

sentences.zh: 比歲賦斂橫出，漕戶困乏，逃亡者有之。

translations.literal: In recent years levies arose at random; transport households are impoverished and exhausted, and some have fled.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years levies arose at random; transport households are impoverished and exhausted, and some have fled.

sentences.zh: 今歲運三百萬，漕舟不足，遣人於浙東、福建等處和顧，百姓騷動。

translations.literal: This year three million are to be transported; transport ships are insufficient; men were sent to Zhedong, Fujian, and other places to hire — the people were alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: This year 3 million are to be transported; transport ships are insufficient; men were sent to Zhedong, Fujian, and other places to hire — the people were alarmed.

sentences.zh: 本省左丞沙不丁，言其弟合八失及馬合謀但的、澉浦楊家等皆有舟，且深知漕事，乞以為海道運糧都漕萬戶府官，各以己力輸運官糧，萬戶、千戶並如軍官例承襲，寬恤漕戶，增給顧直，庶有成效。

translations.literal: This province's left vice director Shabuding said his younger brother Hebashi, Mahemu Dande, the Ganpu Yang clan, and others all have boats and deeply understand transport affairs; we beg they be made officials of the Sea Route Grain Transport Chief Ten-Thousand Households Office, each transport official grain by their own means; ten-thousand and thousand household posts to be inherited like military officers, treat transport households leniently, increase hire payments — then there may be results.
translations.idiomatic: This province's left vice director Shabuding said his younger brother Hebashi, Mahemu Dande, the Ganpu Yang clan, and others all have boats and deeply understand transport affairs; we beg they be made officials of the Sea Route Grain Transport Chief Ten-Thousand Households Office, each transport official grain by their own means; ten-thousand and thousand household posts to be inherited like military officers, treat transport households leniently, increase hire payments — then there may be results.

sentences.zh: 」尚書省以聞，請以馬合謀但的為遙授右丞、海外諸蕃宣慰使、都元帥、領海道運糧都漕運萬戶府事，設千戶所十，每所設達魯花赤一、千戶三、副千戶二、百戶四，制可。

translations.literal: " The Ministry of Revenue reported; it was requested that Mahemu Dande be remotely appointed right vice director, overseer of overseas territories pacification commissioner, commander-in-chief, and director of the Sea Route Chief Transport Ten-Thousand Households Office; ten thousand-household posts established, each with one darughachi, three wanhu, two vice wanhu, and four centurions — approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue reported; it was requested that Mahemu Dande be remotely appointed right vice director, overseer of overseas territories pacification commissioner, commander-in-chief, and director of the Sea Route Chief Transport Ten-Thousand Households Office; ten-thousand household posts established, each with one darughachi, three wanhu, two vice wanhu, and four centurions — approved.

sentences.zh: 雲南省丞相鐵木叠兒擅離職赴都，有旨詰問，以皇太后旨貸免，令復職。

translations.literal: Yunnan branch secretariat censor-in-chief Tegudai'er left his post without authorization to come to the capital; an imperial order questioned him; by the empress dowager's order he was pardoned and ordered back to his post.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan branch secretariat censor-in-chief Tegudai'er left his post without authorization to come to the capital; an imperial order questioned him; by the empress dowager's order he was pardoned and ordered back to his post.

sentences.zh: 以丞相鐵古叠兒為陜西行御史臺御史大夫，詔諭陜西、四川、雲南、甘肅。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Tiegudai'er was made Shaanxi Branch Censorate chief censor; an edict addressed Shaanxi, Sichuan, Yunnan, and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Tiegudai'er was made Shaanxi Branch Censorate chief censor; an edict addressed Shaanxi, Sichuan, Yunnan, and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 詔諭大司農司勸課農桑。

translations.literal: An edict addressed the Chief Agriculture Commission to encourage farming and sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict addressed the Chief Agriculture Commission to encourage farming and sericulture.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌朔，太白犯亢。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiaxu new moon: Venus transgressed Kang.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiaxu new moon: Venus transgressed Kang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，濟寧、東平等路饑，免曾經賑恤諸戶今歲差稅，其未經賑恤者，量減其半。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Jining, Dongping, and other routes suffered famine; households previously relieved are exempt from this year's levies; those not yet relieved have half reduced proportionally.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Jining, Dongping, and other routes suffered famine; households previously relieved are exempt from this year's levies; those not yet relieved have half reduced proportionally.

sentences.zh: 詔諭厘日移文尚書省，凡憲臺除官事，後勿與。

translations.literal: An edict addressed Li Ri: memorials to the Ministry of Revenue — all censorate appointment matters, do not involve them hereafter.
translations.idiomatic: An edict addressed Li Ri: memorials to the Ministry of Revenue — all censorate appointment matters, do not involve them hereafter.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，河南水，死者給槥，漂廬舍者給鈔，驗口賑糧兩月，免今年租賦，停逋責。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Henan suffered flooding; the dead were given coffins; those whose houses were washed away were given notes; grain relief for two months by registered mouths verified; this year's rent and levies remitted; overdue collections halted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Henan suffered flooding; the dead were given coffins; those whose houses were washed away were given notes; grain relief for two months by registered mouths verified; this year's rent and levies remitted; overdue collections halted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，尚書省臣言：「今歲已印至大鈔本一百萬錠，乞增二十萬錠，及銅錢兼行，以備侍衛及鷹坊急有所須。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Ministry of Revenue officials said: "This year one million ingots of Zhidawu notes have already been printed; we beg twenty thousand more be printed, and copper cash circulate together, to supply the guards and falconry office in urgent need.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Ministry of Revenue officials said, "This year 1 million ingots of Zhidawu notes have already been printed; we beg 20,000 more be printed, and copper cash circulate together, to supply the guards and falconry office in urgent need.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「上都、中都銀冶提舉司達魯花赤別都魯思，去歲輸銀四千二百五十兩，今秋復輸三千五百兩，且言復得新礦，銀當增辦，乞加授嘉議大夫。

translations.literal: " They further said: "Shangdu and Zhongdu silver smelting intendant Bedulusi last year submitted four thousand two hundred fifty taels of silver; this autumn submitted three thousand five hundred more, and says a new mine was found — silver production should increase; we beg he be promoted to Grand Master for Glorious Discussion.
translations.idiomatic: They further said, "Shangdu and Zhongdu silver smelting intendant Bedulusi last year submitted 4,250 taels of silver; this autumn submitted 3,500 more, and says a new mine was found — silver production should increase; we beg he be promoted to Grand Master for Glorious Discussion.

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: " Both approved.
translations.idiomatic: Both approved.

sentences.zh: 加脫虎脫為太師、錄軍國重事，封義國公。

translations.literal: Tuohuotuo was promoted to grand preceptor and recorder of military and state affairs, enfeoffed Duke of Yi State.
translations.idiomatic: Tuohuotuo was promoted to grand preceptor and recorder of military and state affairs, enfeoffed Duke of Yi State.

sentences.zh: 壬午，改大崇恩福元寺規運總管府為隆禧院，秩從二品。

translations.literal: On renwu day the Great Chong'en Fuyuan Temple Guiyun overall administration bureau was changed to Longxi Bureau, rank 2b.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the Great Chong'en Fuyuan Temple Guiyun overall administration bureau was changed to Longxi Bureau, rank 2b.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太陰犯畢。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the moon encroached upon Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the moon encroached upon Bi.

sentences.zh: 戊子，改皇太子妃怯憐口都總管府為典內司。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the crown prince's consort Qielian household overall administration bureau was changed to Palace Inner Service.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the crown prince's consort Qielian household overall administration bureau was changed to Palace Inner Service.

sentences.zh: 以益都、寧海等處連歲饑，罷鷹坊縱獵，其餘獵地，並令禁約，以俟秋成。

translations.literal: Because Yidu, Ninghai, and other places suffered famine several years running, falconry hunting was suspended; other hunting grounds also ordered restricted, awaiting autumn harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Because Yidu, Ninghai, and other places suffered famine several years running, falconry hunting was suspended; other hunting grounds also ordered restricted, awaiting autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 尚書省臣言：「雲南省臨安、大理等處宣慰司、麗江宣撫司及普定路所隸部曲，連結蠻寇，殺掠良民，諭之不服，且方調兵討八百媳婦，軍力消耗。

translations.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials said: "Yunnan Lin'an, Dali, and other pacification commissions, Lijiang pacification commission, and Puding Route subordinate tribes have linked with barbarian bandits, killing and plundering good people; admonition does not yield obedience; troops are being mobilized against Babao Xifu and military strength is depleted.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials said, "Yunnan Lin'an, Dali, and other pacification commissions, Lijiang pacification commission, and Puding Route subordinate tribes have linked with barbarian bandits, killing and plundering good people; admonition does not yield obedience; troops are being mobilized against Babao Xifu and military strength is depleted.

sentences.zh: 今擬蒙古軍人給馬一，漢軍十人給馬二，計直與之，乞賜鈔三萬錠。

translations.literal: Now it is proposed — one horse to each Mongol soldier, two horses to each ten Han soldiers, paying fair value; we beg thirty thousand ingots of notes be granted.
translations.idiomatic: Now it is proposed — one horse to each Mongol soldier, two horses to each ten Han soldiers, paying fair value; we beg 30,000 ingots of notes be granted.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「四川行省紹慶路所隸容米洞田墨，連結諸蠻，攻劫麻寮等寨，方調兵討捕，遣千戶塔術往諭田墨施什用等來降。

translations.literal: " They further said: "Sichuan Shaoxing Route's Rongmi Cave Timor has linked various barbarians, attacked Maliao and other stockades; troops are being mobilized for suppression; centurion Tashi was sent to admonish Timor Shishiyong and others to come and surrender.
translations.idiomatic: They further said, "Sichuan Shaoxing Route's Rongmi Cave Timor has linked various barbarians, attacked Maliao and other stockades; troops are being mobilized for suppression; centurion Tashi was sent to admonish Timor Shishiyong and others to come and surrender.

sentences.zh: 宜立黃沙寨，以田墨施什用為千戶，塔術為河東陜西等處萬戶府千戶所達魯花赤，廖起龍為來寧州判官，田思遠為懷德府判官，賞賚遣還。

translations.literal: It is fitting to establish Huangsha Stockade, appointing Timor Shishiyong wanhu, Tashi darughachi of the Hedong-Shaanxi and other places wanhu thousand-household office, Liao Qilong judge of Laining Prefecture, Tian Siyuan judge of Huaide Prefecture; rewards granted and they sent back.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to establish Huangsha Stockade, appointing Timor Shishiyong wanhu, Tashi darughachi of the Hedong-Shaanxi and other places wanhu thousand-household office, Liao Qilong judge of Laining Prefecture, Tian Siyuan judge of Huaide Prefecture; rewards granted and they sent back.

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: " All approved.
translations.idiomatic: All approved.

sentences.zh: 以朱清子虎、張瑄子文龍往治海漕，以所籍宅一區、田百頃給之。

translations.literal: Zhu Qing's son Hu and Zhang Xuan's son Wenlong were sent to manage sea transport; one confiscated residence and one hundred qing of fields were given them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Qing's son Hu and Zhang Xuan's son Wenlong were sent to manage sea transport; one confiscated residence and 100 qing of fields were given them.

sentences.zh: 尚書省臣言：「昔世祖命皇子脫歡為鎮南王居揚州，今其子老章，出入導衛，僣竊上儀。

translations.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials said: "Formerly Shizu appointed Prince Tughan Prince of Zhennan to reside at Yangzhou; now his son Lao Zhang, going in and out with escort guards, usurps imperial regalia.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials said, "Formerly Shizu appointed Prince Tughan Prince of Zhennan to reside at Yangzhou; now his son Lao Zhang, going in and out with escort guards, usurps imperial regalia.

sentences.zh: 敕遣官詰問，仍以所僣儀物來上。

translations.literal: An edict orders officials sent to question him, and the usurped regalia brought up.
translations.idiomatic: An edict orders officials sent to question him, and the usurped regalia brought up.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 敕城中都，以牛車運土，令各部衛士助之，限以來歲四月十五日畢集，失期者罪其部長，自願以車牛輸運者別賞之。

translations.literal: Central Capital construction was ordered — ox carts to transport earth; each guard's warriors ordered to assist; deadline fifteenth day of fourth month next year; those missing the deadline — their chiefs punished; those voluntarily providing carts and oxen for transport separately rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Central Capital construction was ordered — ox carts to transport earth; each guard's warriors ordered to assist; deadline fifteenth day of fourth month next year; those missing the deadline — their chiefs punished; those voluntarily providing carts and oxen for transport separately rewarded.

sentences.zh: 江浙省左丞相答失蠻、江西省左丞相別不花來朝。

translations.literal: Jiang-Zhe left grand councillor Dashiman and Jiangxi left grand councillor Biebuqa came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe left grand councillor Dashiman and Jiangxi left grand councillor Biebuqa came to court.

sentences.zh: 賜世祖宮人伯牙倫金七百五十兩、銀二千五百兩、鈔六百錠。

translations.literal: Shizu palace woman Boyalun was granted seven hundred fifty taels of gold, two thousand five hundred taels of silver, and six hundred ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Shizu palace woman Boyalun was granted 750 taels of gold, 2,500 taels of silver, and 600 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 丙申，有事於南郊，尊太祖皇帝配享昊天上帝。

translations.literal: On bingshen day the Southern Suburb rites were performed; Taizu Emperor honored as paired recipient with August Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Southern Suburb rites were performed; Taizu Emperor honored as paired recipient with August Heaven.

sentences.zh: 己亥，尚書省以武衛親軍都指揮使鄭阿兒思蘭與兄鄭榮祖、段叔仁等圖為不軌，置獄鞫之，皆誣服，詔叔仁等十七人並正典刑，籍沒其家。

translations.literal: On jihai day the Ministry of Revenue reported that Wu Guard personal army commander-in-chief Zheng A'ersilan with elder brother Zheng Rongzu, Duan Shuren, and others plotted rebellion; a case was opened for investigation; all falsely confessed; an edict ordered Shuren and seventeen others all executed by regular law, households registered and property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the Ministry of Revenue reported that Wu Guard personal army commander-in-chief Zheng A'ersilan with elder brother Zheng Rongzu, Duan Shuren, and others plotted rebellion; a case was opened for investigation; all falsely confessed; an edict ordered Shuren and 17 others all executed by regular law, households registered and property confiscated.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰朔，以建大崇恩福元寺，乞失剌遙授左丞，曲列、劉良遙授參知政事，並領行工部事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiachen new moon: because the Great Chong'en Fuyuan Temple was being built, Qishila was remotely appointed left vice director; Qulie and Liu Liang remotely appointed associate administrators, all overseeing Ministry of Works affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiachen new moon: because the Great Chong'en Fuyuan Temple was being built, Qishila was remotely appointed left vice director; Qulie and Liu Liang remotely appointed associate administrators, all overseeing Ministry of Works affairs.

sentences.zh: 立崇輝署，隸中政院。

translations.literal: The Chonghui Bureau was established, subordinate to the Central Domestic Affairs Court.
translations.idiomatic: The Chonghui Bureau was established, subordinate to the Central Domestic Affairs Court.

sentences.zh: 戊申，冀寧路地震。

translations.literal: On wushen day Jining Route suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Jining Route suffered an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 己未，諭中外應避役占籍諸王者，俾充軍驛。

translations.literal: On jiwei day within and without were notified: those who evade corvée by registering under princes shall serve military relay.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day within and without were notified: those who evade corvée by registering under princes shall serve military relay.

sentences.zh: 鎮南王老章僣擬儀衛，究問有驗，召老章赴闕。

translations.literal: Prince of Zhennan Lao Zhang presumptuously imitated guard regalia; investigation found proof; Lao Zhang was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Zhennan Lao Zhang presumptuously imitated guard regalia; investigation found proof; Lao Zhang was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月癸酉朔，帝不豫，免朝賀，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, guiyou new moon: the Emperor was unwell; audiences for congratulations were remitted; a great amnesty was granted throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, spring, first month, guiyou new moon: the Emperor was unwell; audiences for congratulations were remitted; a great amnesty was granted throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，帝崩於玉德殿，在位五年，壽三十一。

translations.literal: On gengchen day the Emperor died in the Yude Hall; he reigned five years; age thirty-one.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Emperor died in the Yude Hall; he reigned five years; age thirty-one.

sentences.zh: 壬午，靈駕發引，葬起輦谷，從諸帝陵。

translations.literal: On renwu day the imperial bier set out; he was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the imperial bier set out; he was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，文武百官也先鐵木兒等上尊謚曰仁惠宣孝皇帝，廟號武宗，國語曰曲律皇帝。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, yiwei day: civil and military officials Yesian Temuer and others presented the posthumous title Renhui Xuanxiao Emperor; temple name Wuzong; in the national language Qulü Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, yiwei day: civil and military officials Yesian Temuer and others presented the posthumous title Renhui Xuanxiao Emperor; temple name Wuzong; in the national language Qulü Emperor.

sentences.zh: 是日，請謚南郊。

translations.literal: That day posthumous rites were performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: That day posthumous rites were performed at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 閏七月丙午，祔於太廟。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, bingwu day: enshrined in the imperial ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary seventh month, bingwu day: enshrined in the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 武宗當富有之大業，慨然欲創治改法而有為，故其封爵太盛，而遙授之官眾，錫賚太隆，而泛賞之恩溥，至元、大德之政，於是稍有變更云。

translations.literal: Wuzong faced a great inheritance of wealth; resolute in wishing to create new governance, reform laws, and act with purpose — therefore his enfeoffments were excessive, remote appointments numerous, bestowals overly lavish, and indiscriminate grace too widely extended; the policies of Zhiyuan and Dade were from this point slightly changed.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzong faced a great inheritance of wealth; resolute in wishing to create new governance, reform laws, and act with purpose — therefore his enfeoffments were excessive, remote appointments numerous, bestowals overly lavish, and indiscriminate grace too widely extended; the policies of Zhiyuan and Dade were from this point slightly changed.
